notes.title: Patch 1.0.3 (Regular Update)
notes.content:
Developer Update

We ended up dropping our new project that we were working on
Instead, we plan to update this game and add game systems we had originally planned before the initial release
Expect new patches and content in the future

Weapons

Axe backstab multiplier buffed (1.25x -> 1.33x)
Pickaxe backstab multiplier added (1.15x)
Bow backstab multiplier added (1.15x)
Other items backstab multiplier added (1.10x)
Stone bow damage (40 -> 50)
Pickaxe and bows destroy webs
Bow animations fixed

Eye Monster Mini Boss Rework

Reworked attack to two NEW attacks
HP set to 450
Increased attack and aggro range
Increased movement speed

Night Spawner

New Boss event system implemented
Night 1: Rock Monster and Wolf
Night 2: Vulture
Night 5: Spiders
Night 8: Mini-bosses (Currently only eye monster)

Environment

Trees are now bigger and vary in size
Apples added to trees
Light added to spider cave arena
Village added with a surprise
Heal flower HP restore buffed (25 -> 50)

Challenges

Removed survive challenge
Reworked epic and legendary challenges to avoid mass-spawning enemies
Adjusted aim challenge

Crafting

Chests can be crafted
Campfires now heal over time
Venison stew added to consumable recipes

Optimization and QoL

Dropped items despawn after 60 seconds
Default mouse sensitivity updated
Enemies spawned from challenges now have are now highlighted and can be seen through terrain

Other

Sam's HP scales more with each additional player in game
Several bugs fixed
Fog of war added
Achievements fixed
WHY IS OPTIMIZATION SO HARD?!?!?!

Links

 Join our Discord Server: https://discord.gg/aksPWa82CT

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1
notes.content:
Night
Night was a little more difficult than we wanted, so we made the following changes:

 Vulture spawns Night 2 onwards
 Eye Monster spawns Night 4  onwards
 Spiders spawns Night 6 onwards
 Enemy spawn rate at night decreased
 Player light appears at sunset now


Performance Issues

 Some people were unable to join the game when the lobby exceeds 4 people, so we set a new max players limit to 4.
 Spider webs spawned from spiders now despawn after 15 seconds. This should help improve performance for some players.


UI Changes and Bug Fixes

 The model of the challenge structures that provide passive abilities were adjusted to differentiate them from shrine structures that provide spell abilities.
 When using the bow, the render distance is increased from the default 150 to 500, and returns back to 150 when the player is done using the bow.
 The spell tutorial now completes when repeat tutorials are run
 Fixed a bug where Sam the Spider UI doesn’t disappear


Other

 The amount of stone and wood was decreased prior to the release, so the stone and wood cost at revive statues was now updated to better match.


We have also created a Discord!!!! Come join to contact the developers and see behind the scenes for upcoming games. 

Join our discord server: Discord Server
